game.title: Working title of the game. Do not translate until a final name is chosen.
hud.hintKeyboard: Shown on devices with a mouse and keyboard. WASD are physical key positions and stay in Latin letters in every language.
hud.hintTouch: Shown on phones and tablets instead of hud.hintKeyboard.
hud.steps: {count} is the distance the hero has walked, in whole steps. Needs every plural form of the target language.
hud.language: Button label. {language} is the language's own name (for example 'Русский') and is not translated.
confirm.newDungeon.yes: Destructive action button. Keep it short: it sits next to another button on a phone screen.
error.body: 'Last stop' means the last time the hero finished walking; that is when the game saves.
